evidence: Labeled P2P and changes compact block prefilling and network processing in src/net_processing.cpp and src/blockencodings.cpp.
rationale: Predictively prefilling compact blocks eliminates a GETBLOCKTXN round-trip for an estimated 43% of block reconstructions, substantially improving network-wide block propagation speed and reducing stale block risk. Reviewers strongly endorse the concept and telemetry, noting the backwards-compatible approach to an established BIP152 limitation.
